results.query: How is interest calculated on the facility and is the interest rate fixed or variable?
results.answer:
Based on the provided documents, interest on the facility is calculated and applied under the following terms and conditions:

### Calculation of Interest
* **Accrual Basis:** All interest accruing on amounts outstanding under the Facility shall accrue from day to day [Page 7, Section vii].
* **Day-Count Convention:** Interest is calculated on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed in a year of three hundred and sixty-five (365) days, or such other days in a year that is customary for any other year [Page 7, Section vii].
* **Overdraft (OD) Facility Calculation:** Interest with respect to the OD facility is calculated on a daily basis as per the utilized amounts from the OD Facility available in the Borrower’s Account at the end-of-day [Page 4, Section 2]. 
* **OD Calculation Period:** Interest for the OD facility is calculated for a period beginning from the 1st day of every month to the end of every month (i.e., 28th, 29th, 30th, or 31st day, as applicable) during the tenure of the Facility [Page 4, Section 2].
* **Payment Schedule:** Interest on the Limit shall be payable by the Borrower every month separately [Page 7, Section viii]. For OD facilities, interest is payable by the 5th of the subsequent calendar month [Page 4, Section 2].

### Fixed vs. Variable Interest Rate
* **Fixed Rate Application:** Interest on the amount of the Facility is to be applied at the fixed rate of interest stipulated in Schedule "B" to the Agreement, and the rate of interest will be fixed for the entire tenure of the Facility [Page 7, Section vii].

results.query: What happens if the borrower prepays or prematurely closes the loan?
results.answer:
If the borrower prepays or prematurely closes the loan, the following terms, conditions, and charges apply:

* **General Agreement:** In the event of prepayment, the borrower agrees that prepayment charges are paid as per the terms of the agreement, out of free will and consent, and without any coercion [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 9].
* **Part Pre-Payment Charges:** 3% plus applicable taxes [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].
* **Foreclosure (Full Pre-Payment) Charges:** 3% plus applicable taxes on the total loan outstanding amount / current limit (Available limit + Utilized limit in case of overdraft) [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].
* **Conditions for Part Pre-Payment and Foreclosure:**
  * Part Pre-Payment or Foreclosure shall be permitted **only after clearance of 12 EMIs** [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].
  * Part-pre-payment will only be allowed **twice in a financial year** [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].
  * Pre-payment of **up to 25% of POS** can only be accepted in a financial year [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].

results.query: What penal charges apply when an EMI is delayed or remains unpaid?
results.answer:
When an EMI is delayed or remains unpaid, the following penal charges and rules apply:

* **Penal Charges Rate:** 6% p.a. plus GST on the overdue amount (Principal overdue / Interest overdue / EMI undue), applicable for the period the said amount remains overdue [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 23, Section Schedule of Charges / Terms Table].
* **Interest on Penal Charges:** No interest will be charged on the outstanding amount of Penal Charges if such charges remain unpaid [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 7].
* **Consequences of Default:** Any delay or default in payment of any EMI makes the Borrower liable to pay Penal Charges as mentioned in Schedule "B", and constitutes a default which makes all sums under the Agreement due and payable to the Lender forthwith [pl-loan-agreement-english-v290325.pdf, Page 7].

results.query: What interest rate structure (Adjustable / Fixed Rate) and conversion options apply under HDFC Home Loan?
results.answer:
Based on the provided documents, the interest rate structures and conversion options under HDFC Home Loan include the following:

### **1. Interest Rate Structure**
* **Adjustable Rate Home Loan (ARHL) / Floating Rate:** Defined as a floating rate of interest expressed as a percentage per annum. It is calculated as the sum total of the **Reference Rate applicable for the Loan plus the applicable Spread** [Page 3].
* **Reset Conditions:** Subject to change or reset by the Bank from time to time whenever the Reference Rate is changed or reset by the Bank in accordance with the guidelines or regulations of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The changed or reset rate of interest applies from the time of such change or reset till the next change or reset [Page 3].
* **Reference Rate:** Defined as an internal or external benchmark/reference rate prescribed by the Bank, used to determine the total interest rate by adding a spread or similar margin [Page 5].

### **2. Conversion Options and Associated Fees** [⚠ This claim could not be verified against the documents]
The provided documents outline specific fees and charges applicable when switching or converting rates:
* **Standard Conversion Fee:** **1.75%** of the Principal Outstanding and Undisbursed amount (if any) **plus applicable taxes / statutory levies** at the time of conversion [Page 53].
* **Switch to Lower Rate (Plot Loans - Variable Rate):** **0.5%** of the principal outstanding and undisbursed amount (if any) **plus applicable taxes/statutory levies** at the time of conversion [Page 53].
* **Switch to Lower Rate (Loans under HDFC Reach - Variable Rate):** **Upto 1.50%** of the principal outstanding and undisbursed amount (if any) **plus applicable taxes/statutory levies** at the time of conversion [Page 53].

results.query: What property security, mortgage creation, and insurance obligations are required by HDFC under Article 4?
results.answer:
Based on the provided documents, the property security, mortgage creation, and insurance obligations required by HDFC under Article 4 (specifically Article 4.2) and related definitions are as follows:

* **Creation of Security Interest:** 
  * The Borrower/Security Provider, to the extent applicable, must create and perfect, or undertake to create and perfect, a Security Interest over the Property or such other assets as may be required by the Bank.
  * This must be done within such time period as may be specified by the Bank [Page 8, Section 4 (c)].
* **Conditions Precedent to First Disbursement:** 
  * To avail of the first disbursement under the loan, each condition precedent must be complied with, or caused to be complied with, by the Borrower and the Security Providers, unless specifically waived by the Bank in writing [Page 8, Section 4.2.1].
  * The Borrower must assure the Bank that they or the Security Provider have complied with all pre-conditions for disbursement of the loan as detailed in the agreement and the Applicable Schedules [Page 8, Section 4.2.1(a)].
* **Definition of Security Interest & Insurance Obligation:**
  * A "Security Interest" includes any mortgage, pledge, hypothecation, assignment, deposit arrangement, encumbrance, lien (statutory or other), preference, priority, interest, or other security arrangement of any kind or nature whatsoever [Page 5, Section (jj)].
  * This encompasses conditional sales, title retention arrangements, financing statements/notices pertaining to the Property or assets, and **any designation of loss payees or beneficiaries or any similar arrangement under any contract of insurance** or any other similar security interest created in favour of the Bank [Page 5, Section (jj)].
